description: After #1573, sync-results-data-to-published.yml posts a real corpus-mirror/validate-bundles check that runs scripts/validate_submission.py on every changed primary bundle. That validator requires summary.validation=='passed' (community submission rule). The curated seed corpus has always included ~65 bundles with validation=partial (203 primary total). Result: every full-corpus re-derive mirror fails the check even when privacy is clean (0 path leaks, 0 drop-field keys post-#1578). PR #1583 had to be admin-merged for tip hygiene after #1578. Community submissions must still refuse partial; the defect is applying that bar to trusted maintainer auto/results-mirror-* same-repo mirrors without a waiver or a separate privacy+inventory gate.
